basic_info.description: This quintessential + extremely bright BEACH BUNGALOW has an inviting layout, blending comfort and style, with over 1,600sqft of thoughtfully designed living space. Picture perfect sun-drenched living room w/large windows + cozy fireplace opens to bright, massive dining room ready to entertain. Three spacious, private bedrooms. Kitchen equipped with modern appliances located just off the backyard for grilling ease + enjoyment. Prepare a casual meal or host a dinner party, this space caters to all your cooking needs. Immediate access to outdoor space is RARE and makes all the difference when it comes to utilizing and thoroughly enjoying a home's outdoor space. Downstairs is a spacious, bright family room/bedroom and a separate in-home gym/office. This property provides ample room for relaxation and privacy.    Updates throughout. W/D hookups, massive clean garage, loads of storage. The functioning chicken coop is a fun bonus! Escape the City at this amazing and stylish retreat by the beach!    Steps to popular Balboa Village, where locals go to hang out, eat, see an old flick/concert at iconic Balboa Theater or say hi to neighbors along the way. Blocks to some of the best Surf, biking trails, parks and beach walks SF has to offer. Come by my neighbor!
